summary: NDR on c018_nic is dropping 2.59% of packets at its capture interface (103,860 discards) due to overload, exceeding 0.1% threshold. Link is healthy but tool cannot keep up.

findings.root_cause: Traffic volume delivered to NDR eth1 exceeds the 10G capture pipeline capacity. The NIC/kernel is discarding packets before the NDR can analyze them (2.59% loss), not a link CRC or broker drop.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses ~1 in 38 packets, breaking TCP reassembly, flow records and detection. Results in false negatives, missed C2/beaconing and incomplete forensic evidence despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Discards are at the tool itself (could not keep up), not the network. Reduce load to this 10G interface via load_balance across multiple NDR instances/sensors, filter irrelevant traffic at packet broker, or upgrade tool capacity/NIC tuning (RSS, buffers, capture drivers) to handle peak rate.
